edbDesc: (or Thermal decomposition) A chemical decomposition caused by heat. The reaction is usually endothermic as heat is required to break chemical bonds in the compound undergoing decomposition. If decomposition is sufficiently exothermic, a positive feedback loop is created producing thermal runaway and possibly an explosion.
title: Thermolysis
pickWhy: Thermal decomposition is the general form of pyrolysis (heating without air), in another batch; if pyrolysis isn't kept, drop as a general chemical process.
